_comment: Autoresearch context-integrity hooks — the MERGE SNIPPET. The repo had no .claude/settings.json, so these three hook blocks were merged into a fresh .claude/settings.json. If a settings.json already exists in a future checkout, hand-merge these entries under hooks.PreToolUse / hooks.PostToolUse / hooks.SessionStart (additive — do not replace existing arrays). Only the context-integrity gate is wired here; no Basis-OS scripts (scope-guard, stop-verify, etc.) are referenced because they do not exist in this repo.
